Orchestral Waltz of the Flowers; first record side Documented

Commons gives catalogue K 1144, order AR 9079 and matrix/stamper AR 9079-2; the subsequent side is not concatenated.

[1]
Recorded
January 1945; sources give 18 or 26 January Disputed: sources disagree

Commons gives 18 January 1945 for this side. Damian’s 78s lists matrices AR 9079-2 and 9080-2 among tracks recorded on 26 January 1945, with tracks 1–⁠5 on 18 January. Both place the session at Kingsway Hall and the release in September 1945.
